newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Reuters to set up Philippines dealing system.
newsitem.headline: Reuters to set up Philippines dealing system.

text.p: The Bankers Association of the Philippines (BAP) has appointed Reuters Limited as the prime provider of dealing systems for Philippine peso/U.S. dollar transactions.
Dealing systems provided by Reuters will begin operations on April 2 and will provide real-time prices and facilities for banks to match trades, BAP said.
BAP said that it and Reuters were also working toward setting up a dealing and information system for government securities.
BAP's dealing systems are currently operated by the U.S. information company Dow Jones Telerate. Under the new arrangement, Reuters will be the prime provider of dealing systems.
No other company has yet been authorised to provide dealing systems, BAP said. However, Reuters has agreed to provide technical assistance to any other company that is appointed, it said.
"We are pleased and proud to be able to serve the Philippine market with one of our most prestigious products," said John Atkinson, Manager, Philippines for Reuters Limited.
